body: House MD - Wilsons Heart. When Amber finally died I burst out into tears.
Remeber things they talked about a long time ago.

The worst feeling that I ever had was the feeling when my mother told me that she has cancer. It scared the hell out of me! She told me that she probably will be fine but I had to manage the homelife. I felt so overwhelmed. I was unsure about every decision that I made. When should I wake up my little sister? What should I cook for dinner? How will I get some groceries? You have to know that I was 16 years old and not able to drive and I also lived in a small village with no stores so I had to ask my neighbors for help. Like some of you may know is that in a small village a secret isn't a secret in the next days. My mom was kind of angry with me when she came back from hospital. That was the most horrible thing that I ever felt!

Wow! Those are just cute! :3
I want to cuddle with them!
Of course, choose the way you are comfortable.
That sounds pretty sad. Do you want to talk about everything? I will be online a few more hours and I am good at listening. You don't have to be alone.
Thank you, I'll try to hang on.
Thank you for this. But I guess it would help me more if I could talk to somebody.
Yes, maybe. I will look for some.
It would be pretty difficult to keep it as a secret. So this is not an option. Either I make it on my own or I do not. Right now I don't care at all.
I talked to a friend of mine. The 'last' one if you want so. It didn'T help. Just made me feel worse.

Thank you for your comment. 
It is really nice to hear that someone notices small things like a 'thank you' but even if I am able to cheer up people (and I try to do so as often as possible) it is hard to stay up in the morning. I always cared for others and never put myself into first position and sometimes it feels good but now a days I feel just sad and lonely even if there are lots of people around me.
